title: Support of a multi-index
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $I$ a type with decidable equality, $i_0\in I$, and $a$ a multi-index of length $n$ with values in $I$. The support of $a$ relative to $i_0$ is the set of positions $j$ for which $a(j)\ne i_0$.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-index $a$ of length $n$ with values in $I$
